mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_change WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND verification_status='VERIFIED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zentide_user_action(user_id,change_id,action_type,action_value,status) VALUES(#{userId},#{changeId},'STANCE',#{stanceType},'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE action_value=VALUES(action_value),status='ACTIVE',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(action_value='ACTIONED'),0) AS actioned_count, COALESCE(SUM(action_value='PLANNING'),0) AS planning_count, COALESCE(SUM(action_value='WATCHING'),0) AS watching_count, COALESCE(SUM(action_value='BLOCKED'),0) AS blocked_count, COALESCE(SUM(action_value='NOT_RELEVANT'),0) AS not_relevant_count FROM zentide_user_action WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND action_type='STANCE' AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT action_value FROM zentide_user_action WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND action_type='STANCE' AND status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
